label: Xero documents
description: One record per invoice and per credit note the app creates in Xero, or tried to create. The app uses it to never create a document twice, and to continue one where an attempt stopped.

key.label: Key
key.description: The order or the refund the document belongs to. Unique, so each gets one document.

source.label: Started by
source.description: The store event or dashboard action that asked for the document.

name.label: Name
name.description: The document number once Xero has assigned one, the order until then.

number.label: Number
number.description: The invoice or credit note number Xero assigned.

invoice_number.label: For invoice
invoice_number.description: On a credit note: the invoice it refunds.

reference.label: Refund reference
reference.description: Tells the refunds of one order apart in the credit note's reference.

tax_note.label: Xero tax rates
tax_note.description: The tax rates the invoice uses, or how sales tax is shown.

xero_status.label: Status in Xero
xero_status.description: As it was when the app last read it.

contact_key.label: Contact key
contact_key.description: Orders with the same key share one Xero contact.

payment_method.label: Refunded by
payment_method.description: On a credit note: the payment method of the refund, which decides the Xero account the refund is paid out from.

date_booked.label: Payments handled
date_booked.description: Set once the app has dealt with the payments, whether or not anything was recorded.

date_submitted.label: Submitted
date_submitted.description: Set while a create request to Xero has no answer yet.

date_pending.label: Waiting since
date_pending.description: Set while the document waits for Xero. After a day of waiting it is listed under Needs attention.
